title: A Bell for the Smile
author: Silas Crane
blurb: Emrys Coldharbour, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
